featured_reviews.name: Mohammed Jumboo
featured_reviews.review_text: The worst experience of buying a second hand car of my life. This was my first car, a hyundai i10 sports which I bought from a sweet talking uncle who is also  one of the owners of OM motors. I read the reviews of OM motors which as per the review is excellent online, I purchased a car which was a 2013 I10 Hyundai sports. While taking the test drive, the car did not start initially, the uncle said beta that's because of the battery, I will change it for you, I got the car at 3.50lakhs. he provided me with previous servicing papers and 6 months warranty for the car in case of any issues. After a week of the  car being with me, it started giving me starting problems, it would not start, I changed the battery to a new battery as I was given the same old battery. Again I had starting issues. I went to the showroom for a thorough check up of the car and I was advised it was a flooded car i.e. it had been in flood water and because of it you are having this problem. I called the uncle and said about the issues, he as a smooth talker told me beta I have been just operated upon and now that you bought the car which will stay with you for a long time why not do the repair work ,so I asked about the six month warranty and he bluntly said I can't do anything about it since when you took the car it was fine and does not count into the warranty. I was stunned and felt miserable. I have spent 50000 on the car to repair the problem. My problem is that the trust once broken will always stay broken. I will never recommend buying a second hand car from OM motors ever to anyone. If you still want to buy it , then please ensure to get a experienced mechanic along so that you don't get cheated like I was. Because blindly trusted whatever I was told about the car. I just regret this whole experience. I wish it would never had happened. I am have added the picture of the cars with the number plate depicting that I bought it from OM motors to verify the authenticity of this post. I am a genuine customer who does not wish for someone else to go through what I went through and thus I am providing a detailed description.

This is Genuine review:

April or may i guess Recently purchased i10 from them. First of all as per my experience price is high as compared to other dealers but yes car was in condition (because recently painted).

Experience was average because when we tried test drive the left tyre was puncture of the car which was informed to Jatin sales person he said he will tc of that part. And why they fixed the pipe so beware of that other person in office he tries to fool u on every work Dealer has to do and tell this is ok that is ok this much you can also do but not sure why we will do when we r paying them the price.Dhaval dont like when u highlight the work they have to do his thinking  is take car pay me as per my demand but work i willnot do u do.

Ok coming back to punctured tyre the dealer didn't fixed it and shown his level of professionalism. He only fixed it with air and said yes it is done. Not sure why he did it for 100 rs puncture work.

Ok now when i highlighted this and asked the owner dhaval reply was Gaadi lete jaate waqt puncture hua hoga utna ab humlog kese karega aapko gaadi bhi kam rate me di whereas he really made good profit by saving 100 rs on tyre.

My question to sales person was how same tyre got punctured immediate next day?

Well next point the hazard light button was damaged and it is still damaged cos cannot be fixed in i10.
Speakers were not working properly so i had to fix it also.

Overall avarage experience only Dhavals 100 rs and that other person customer handling was un expected and worst.
After 5 months of use now car gave me total expenditure of 40-45000 in total. Silencer was damaged, battery was fake of wagonr 35ah ac coil was damaged and fixed with glue tyres were gone tail light was damaged from inside.
Coolant was filled with water, engine oil was with Kachra. Car is painted cos of rust to hide it putti work done to hide dents. So total 40k spent on 2L car so far and wherever i go all says car is costly almost 50-60k i paid extra. So you check everything and if you want to buy pls go ahead this is my genuine experience

So yes make sure u do mechanic check before buying any car.

Rest experience is below average

featured_reviews.name: Rishabh Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience with Regent Tata Motors, Borivali East.

I initially booked a vehicle in Virtual Sunrise Blue colour and paid a booking amount and based on the assurance that the car would be available. Later, I was informed that this colour could not be arranged. Based on their commitment, I agreed to switch to Pure Grey, with a promise of delivery within a few days.

However, after some time, I was again informed that the delivery would take an additional 10–12 days, with a firm assurance that the vehicle would be delivered by the end of the month. Despite these repeated commitments, the dealership failed to deliver the car. Instead, I was again asked to compromise on a different colour.

This entire process wasted nearly a month of my time. I remained patient and loyal to proceed with the purchase from them, but due to continuous delays and unfulfilled promises, I had no option but to cancel the booking.

Overall, the experience reflects poor service, lack of transparency, and failure to honor commitments. I would advise potential buyers to proceed with caution.

Thanks a Lot!

5-Star Review for 2 Pahiya Motors

I recently purchased the TVS Jupiter 125 from 2 Pahiya Motors, and I must say, the entire experience was absolutely seamless. The service was top-notch, and the staff was incredibly polite and professional.

A special thanks to Mr. Salman Sir and Mr. Suraj Sharma Sir – both were extremely humble, helpful, and attentive throughout the process. I had an urgent need to get my scooter registered quickly due to a travel issue, and Mr. Suraj Sharma went the extra mile to ensure I received my registration number within just one day. That kind of dedication is truly commendable!

Thank you to the entire 2 Pahiya Motors team for your efforts and excellent customer service. I’m very happy with my new scooter and the overall experience.

Highly recommended!
